title: Train the price CNN on all eligible rolling price windows
question: Does dense price-only training establish useful forecasting compared with the previous event-only CNN training?
configuration: none+CNN~none~none on SPX-PX-GRID5-v1 (204,694 train) or SPX-PX-GRID15-v1 (68,219 train), common SPX-PX-GRID5-v1 validation (40,548), 35 historical bars, 20/30-minute returns, original five-minute processing lag, batch 64, AdamW 0.001, 30 epochs. One bounded single-GPU job planned.
finding: Real-input audit passed with zero shared train/validation bars and explicit separation from reserved test support. Four focused clock, purging, stride and missing-bar checks passed. Training has not been submitted.
limitations: Correlated overlapping windows; dense-training RMS scaling and training population change together. Validation is exploratory. No text arm or reserved-test result is included.
